response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT s.entrystat, e.ambictemp, e.imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref) SELECT entrystat, AVG(ambictemp) AS avg_ambient_temp, AVG(imgcount) AS avg_image_count, AVG(imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM j) AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM j GROUP BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: The overall image-count average is taken over the same population, meaning environment records that match a site. It ignores NULL image counts.
Records are matched to sites with an inner join on zoneref = zoneregistry. Sites with no environment records don't appear. A NULL entrystat, if present, forms its own group.
AVG skips NULLs, and no rounding is applied.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall image-count average is taken over all environment records, including any that don't match a site.
alternatives.sql: SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambient_temp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_image_count, AVG(e.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM scanenvironment) AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref GROUP BY s.entrystat
